result.title: System-One RSI: Building Muscle Memory for Interactive Agents through Guided Practice
result.summary: Reasoning models provide strong multimodal task understanding but struggle with sub-second control because deliberation increases decision latency. Fast decision models can meet the response window, yet prompting and few-shot examples do not readily provide the fine-grained experience required by a new task. Inspired by coached motor learning, this paper presents System-One Recursive Self-Improvement (System-One RSI), which couples two loops. The high-frequency online inner loop is an Observe, Orient, Decide, Act (OODA) cycle: a decision model maps each visual observation and task question to structured judgments, and a decision tree converts them into timed actions without invoking a reasoning model. The offline outer loop is a recursive improvement cycle carried out by a team of reasoning agents. The team revises the decision-model prompt and decision tree, captures interaction records, derives supervision from those records, and trains or deploys updated model parameters. The improved system then returns to the environment and generates the experience for the next round, consolidating learned distinctions as external muscle memory. The framework operates with a small number of real episodes, without expert demonstrations, environment modification, sandboxing, or parallel simulation. Experiments in Snake, Zenless Zone Zero, and Black Myth: Wukong use a 27B decision model. Mean Snake score increases from 1.30 to 7.35. In an evaluated scenario of Zenless Zone Zero, median completion time decreases by 8.4%. In an evaluated combat scenario of Black Myth: Wukong, the evasive policy achieves 11 times the mean survival time of a stationary reference, while the offensive policy win rate rises from 0% to 66.7% across the evaluated configurations.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 System-One RSI 双循环框架：在线 OODA 循环让决策模型把视觉观测与任务问题映射为结构化判断，再由决策树转成定时动作、不调用推理模型；离线由推理智能体团队改写 prompt 与决策树、从交互记录提取监督并训练更新参数，在 Snake 与两款 3D 游戏中验证。
AI.relevance_reason: 结构化判断加决策树构成显式中间状态瓶颈，「从交互记录反推监督」与慢推理到快决策的分工，可供核查 LVR 中轨迹级监督、答案是否真正使用中间状态以及 THINK/STOP 成本权衡；论文本身不研究 latent 多模态推理，迁移属推测。
